name: Family ventures and wealth
description: What the Trump family's businesses, licensing entities and extended relatives have earned, and how the totals are estimated.

name: Crypto ventures
description: The meme coins, World Liberty Financial, the USD1 stablecoin and bitcoin companies tied to the Trump family, and who put money into them.

name: Trump Media and markets
description: Trump Media & Technology Group, its financial products and backers, and the effect of presidential posts on markets.

name: Gulf money
description: Investments, gifts and licensing deals involving the UAE, Saudi Arabia and Qatar, and the US decisions affecting those states.

name: Foreign deals
description: Business projects and financial ties outside the Gulf, set beside US policy toward the countries involved.

name: Regulators and enforcement
description: Decisions by the SEC, the CFTC, the OCC and other agencies affecting companies with financial ties to the Trump family or its donors, and the officials who took them.

name: Pardons, lobbyists and access
description: Clemency decisions, paid lobbying and other routes by which companies, donors and foreign governments reach the White House.

name: Defence, minerals and contracts
description: Federal contracts, loans and equity stakes in defence, drone and critical-minerals companies with ties to the Trump family, officials or donors.

name: Tech and media companies
description: Technology and media companies that made payments, settlements or donations while they had business before the federal government.
